scope: Exploratory transfer to doccloud_base only, chosen after inspecting its requirements and plan; not a full second-family audit
question: Do original acceptance checks require non-owner ACL ViewDocument and ModifyDocument access?
construction: Use the pinned released candidate as baseline, then append a forbid for non-owner User ViewDocument and ModifyDocument requests on Document resources.
probes: Authenticated, non-owner, non-private User, no mutual blocking, membership in the respective viewACL or modifyACL
acceptance: Both policies must validate and run all original checks; only an accepted narrowed policy supports the adequacy claim
controls: Baseline probe coverage and probe nonemptiness. No Public-principal claim because the prose and global authentication gate need separate interpretation.
rejection: Report rejection if any original obligation fails; do not alter the narrowing to rescue the result
provenance: Released workspace is not asserted to be the unavailable final inspected repair-pass output
